content: {"question":"If I move from GitLab Canada Corp to GitLab LTD (UK), how do the employer contributions differ between the Canadian CPP plan and the UK pension scheme for bonus or commission payments?","answer":"In Canada, GitLab makes employer contributions to the CPP on your behalf, whereas in the UK employer contributions are not applied to bonus or commission earnings.","evidence_a":"GitLab makes employer contributions to CPP on your behalf.","evidence_b":"Employer contributions are not applied to Bonus or Commission earnings."}
